connector.name: Worldku Memory
connector.registryDescription: Save AI conversations into your Worldku memory and recall them from any MCP client.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.worldku.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.worldku, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Worldku MCP access key as a Bearer token (create at worldku.com under Memory manager - AI tools). OAuth-capable clients can omit this and use the advertised OAuth 2.1 authorization server instead.
